headline: Florida Southern win a fourth and concede a first
dek: Florida Southern's fourth win came at Mississippi College, and it was the first match in which they conceded. Twelve scored and one allowed; Ricardo Marques had kept three clean sheets before the goal went in.
displaced_by: Florida Southern conceded their first goal at Mississippi College; the standing dek said nobody had scored against them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and have conceded once while doing it.

wire.line: Eckerd have lost three straight without scoring; their only goals came in the win that opened their season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Three matches have passed their date with no result at all, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's, among them the match against Barry, a fellow member.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Nova Southeastern won for the first time at Montevallo, having lost both home matches, to Carson-Newman and Lincoln Memorial.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn are unbeaten but have drawn their last two on the road, after beating Mississippi College at home in their opener.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Henry Obi has made seventeen saves for Barry and conceded seven, without a clean sheet.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins have scored ten and conceded eight, and are still unbeaten after two wins and a draw.

last_match.line: Nova Southeastern's first win of the season, in their first match away from home.

next_match.line: Tampa are still looking for a first win after draws with West Alabama and Clayton State.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
